wire.method: New independent implementation of the documented common UDTV wire; no PX4 wire source was copied or modified.
wire.scope: UDTV 1.0 envelope and bounded frame/header handling; typed HELLO request, HELLO response, error response, ACQUIRE request/response, LIST/STATUS snapshots (producer, context, topology, enclosure, USB functions, receiver/reader descriptors and status, measurements and counters), TUNE request/result, START/ATTACH/STOP/RELEASE, TS_DATA, STATE_EVENT/STREAM_END and the CARD_*/transaction records, all with bounded storage, control-payload cap preflight and cross-record validators. json.method: New independent portable serializer; it consumes the existing typed STATUS records and full canonical-context validator.
json.scope: STATUS JSON size and encode APIs, compact UTF-8 object serialization with a final newline, checked caller-capacity handling, canonical collection ordering, and JSON error-symbol projection. Unknown JSON codes retain their full u32 value in numeric_code, and present code 0 is rejected by existing record validation.

packet_session.incarnation_exception: The sole approved behavior exception is a session-local nonwrapping u64 incarnation. It is incremented under the same session mutex at admitted logical attachment publication (including a publication whose later bridge startup fails) and never on validation/BUSY/allocation rejection. A read captures it when it first validates the attachment, includes the mismatch in its wait predicate, and checks it immediately after wait/reacquisition before any packet, counter, draining, or final access, returning NOT_FOUND without touching the replacement session. A same-incarnation empty detach keeps the old already-validated reader EOF. Incarnation exhaustion rejects the next logical attach with RESOURCE_LIMIT after the external validation/BUSY checks and before allocating or mutating state; there is no wrap, global shutdown, or physical reset. This is not the old source expression and has no existing oracle.
